title: Create a record and verify commit
purpose: Create one record in an explicit context, set approved fields, verify the commit immediately, and return a JSON result.
preconditions: Required input is validated before entering the record-creation flow.
The target layout and table occurrence are resolved and suitable for record creation.
The account used in the selected execution context has create and field-edit privileges.
The primary-key generation method is resolved from the target solution; this pattern never invents one.
Any optional idempotency field and key are both resolved or both omitted.

placeholders.name: TARGET_TABLE_OCCURRENCE
placeholders.resolutionSource: the resolved base table occurrence of {{TARGET_LAYOUT}}

placeholders.name: PRIMARY_KEY_FIELD
placeholders.resolutionSource: target FileMaker solution metadata and data-model contract

placeholders.name: GENERATED_PRIMARY_KEY_EXPRESSION
placeholders.resolutionSource: the target solution's approved primary-key generation rule

placeholders.name: FIELD_ASSIGNMENTS
placeholders.resolutionSource: the validated payload contract and target FileMaker solution metadata

placeholders.name: IDEMPOTENCY_FIELD
placeholders.resolutionSource: an existing target-solution field approved for idempotency

steps.name: Set Error Capture
steps.purpose: Keep create, field, commit, and revert failures under script control.

partialConditions.psos: FMSE always behaves as Set Error Capture On; do not depend on an Off state.
partialConditions.server_schedule: FMSE always behaves as Set Error Capture On; do not depend on an Off state.

partialConditions.psos: Do not use animation; resolve the layout explicitly because client context is not inherited.
partialConditions.server_schedule: Do not use animation; resolve the layout explicitly because no client context exists.

steps.name: New Record/Request
steps.purpose: Create exactly one new record in {{TARGET_TABLE_OCCURRENCE}}.

steps.name: Set Field
steps.purpose: Set the resolved primary key, approved payload fields, and optional idempotency value.

steps.name: Commit Records/Requests
steps.purpose: Commit without a dialog and expose validation, privilege, and uniqueness failures.

partialConditions.psos: With dialog must be Off; save and validate record data explicitly.
partialConditions.server_schedule: With dialog must be Off; save and validate record data explicitly.

steps.name: Revert Record/Request
steps.purpose: Optionally discard the uncommitted record only under a reviewed failure policy.

partialConditions.psos: With dialog must be Off; reverting discards all uncommitted changes in the current record.
partialConditions.server_schedule: With dialog must be Off; reverting discards all uncommitted changes in the current record.

steps.name: Set Variable
steps.purpose: Capture Get ( LastError ) immediately after create, each field assignment, commit, and optional revert.

steps.name: If
steps.purpose: Branch on creation, assignment, commit, and idempotency outcomes.

steps.name: Else
steps.purpose: Separate successful commit from reviewed failure recovery.

steps.name: Exit Script
steps.purpose: Return the created primary key or a common error result.

functions.name: Get ( LastError )
functions.purpose: Preserve each create, field, commit, and revert result before another step runs.

functions.name: JSONSetElement
functions.purpose: Build the common result with the created primary-key value.

happyPath: Validate required input before creating a record.
If {{IDEMPOTENCY_FIELD}} and {{IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_EXPRESSION}} are both resolved, check the approved idempotency rule before creation; otherwise omit that feature explicitly.
Create a new record and immediately capture Get ( LastError ).
Set {{PRIMARY_KEY_FIELD}} from {{GENERATED_PRIMARY_KEY_EXPRESSION}} and apply {{FIELD_ASSIGNMENTS}}, checking each Set Field result.
Commit Records/Requests with dialog Off and immediately preserve Get ( LastError ).
Return CREATED with the resolved primary-key value only after a zero commit error.

errorBranches.action: Stop before assigning fields and return the preserved FileMaker code.
Stop further assignments and apply the reviewed commit/revert policy.

errorBranches.trigger: The account cannot create the record or edit a required field.
errorBranches.action: Return an authorization failure without exposing protected data.

errorBranches.trigger: Commit fails a field validation or required-value rule.
errorBranches.action: Return a validation result and use Revert only if the reviewed policy permits data loss.

errorBranches.trigger: Commit reports that a field value is not unique.
errorBranches.action: Return a deterministic conflict; do not generate a replacement identifier unless the business rule explicitly allows it.

errorBranches.trigger: Commit returns any other nonzero result.
errorBranches.action: Preserve the error, report that the record may remain open and uncommitted, and follow the reviewed revert policy.

errorBranches.trigger: The resolved idempotency rule finds that the request was already applied.
errorBranches.action: Return the prior logical result or a conflict according to the approved contract; do not create another record.

concurrencyNotes: PSOS and scheduled scripts can create records concurrently; a preflight find alone cannot guarantee uniqueness.
Use an existing unique field or approved idempotency field when the business operation must be exactly-once or retry-safe.
Do not invent {{IDEMPOTENCY_FIELD}}. If it is absent, document the duplicate-creation risk and omit the optional feature.
Commit failure can leave the new record open with uncommitted changes; recovery must be explicit.
securityNotes: Verify create and per-field edit privileges for the account used in every supported context.
Do not return fields outside the approved result contract.
Revert Record/Request can discard uncommitted data and must never be an unconditional generic cleanup step.
Do not log raw sensitive payload values or idempotency secrets.
